claim_boundaries: Two exposed historical development issues; three correlated issuers per issue, not six independent trials.
The numerical operator uses prices only although the full graph also reads news; no incremental news value measured.
Unchanged-rule and persistence controls are deterministic calculations, not separate native model arms.
Daily no_change preserves experimental lineage; it does not select the candidate as a winner.
Source hashes bind local evidence; full upstream text and agent transcripts are not publicly redistributed.
Historical availability, model memory and revised prices remain unresolved. No prospective or profitability claim.
conclusion: The reviewed shrinkage candidate lost to unchanged-rule arithmetic on its next issue; no promotion or learned advantage.

change.skill_addon: Use only as-of supplied facts and original S_/N_ IDs; never invent missing data or a causal story. For the EMPIRICAL development control keep trailing_mean_return_v1, five returns, cap0.02 and all admitted stocks, but set scale0.125. This is an UNVALIDATED shrinkage candidate after one poor issue, not a fitted optimum or proven lesson. Preserve source baselines, exact rule arithmetic and next-session evaluation; compare with unchanged scale0.25 and persistence.

response.diagnosis: The first frozen empirical control had greater mean absolute and squared normalized-return error than unchanged prices. MSFT and HON directions missed while JNJ hit. There is no demonstrated input or arithmetic error, and no basis to infer a hidden cause. Propose one smaller scale (0.25 to0.125) to test whether reducing uncalibrated forecast magnitude helps on the next day. This is a development intervention motivated by observed loss, not an estimated optimal coefficient.

evidence.value: The unvalidated price-history control got1/3 directions right. Mean absolute normalized-return error was0.009864865810877007 versus persistence0.009304723603005285; mean squared error0.00010587887575844201 versus0.00009331965601153313. Outcomes were mixed and do not identify cause. These are three correlated issuers on one date, not three independent trials.

response.test: Run the full successor Lab before July28 truth with the same five-return method, cap and all three equities. Record candidate error and compare its deterministic arithmetic with unchanged scale0.25 and persistence on the same later input. Treat that comparison as a bounded control diagnostic, not a completed native20-date generation matchoff or evidence of learned advantage.
response.uncertainty: One date with three correlated equities is insufficient to select a durable rule. Shrinking can reduce losses when direction is wrong but sacrifices useful amplitude when direction is correct. News value is not tested by this price-only formula.

rule.selection_basis: First unvalidated native control. Five trailing returns use the existing feed window; quarter-scale shrinks its noisy mean toward persistence. Parameters are declared before July27 truth, not fitted.

response.diagnosis: The stored scale change was used by the next full Lab and its arithmetic was correct. Its July28 mean absolute normalized error was 0.006253138821336595, lower than persistence but higher than unchanged-rule arithmetic 0.005957475474076736. Shrinkage helped the HON direction miss and hurt the two hits. The candidate therefore has no basis for promotion from this diagnostic. Make no further parameter or node change from this two-date sample. This preserves the experimental policy lineage without selecting a winner or claiming that the current candidate is better.

evidence.value: The successor made two of three directions correctly. Mean absolute normalized-return error was 0.006253138821336595 versus unchanged-rule arithmetic 0.005957475474076736 and persistence 0.006548802168596267. Mean squared errors were 0.000048332494240137996, 0.00004577077748488238 and 0.00005166301734589641 respectively. The reviewed shrinkage change did not beat the unchanged rule on this subsequent issue. Controls are deterministic arithmetic on identical inputs, not separately executed native arms. No cause or durable learning advantage is established.

value.selection_basis: Reviewed development candidate after July27 matured: halve unvalidated scale, preserve method, lookback, cap and all targets. No optimal coefficient or learned advantage is established.

response.test: Keep both policies as unselected candidates. A future matched cohort must freeze both on the same later dates, include persistence, retain all errors and separate further development from an untouched assessment. First inspect whether informative as-of issuer text permits an auditable numerical hypothesis; do not spend a large cohort to relabel this wiring diagnostic as useful financial reasoning.
response.uncertainty: The three stocks are dependent observations within one later date. The unchanged rule is an arithmetic control rather than an independently executed second native arm. This price-only operator has not measured the contribution of news or the rest of the reasoning graph. No causal explanation or durable forecasting advantage follows.
